caption: This drawing, rendered in a single shade of reddish-brown on a cream-colored background, contains several allegorical and historical figures distributed across the surface. In the upper left, a classical temple structure with columns stands on stepped rocks, housing a seated woman blowing a trumpet and holding a staff. Below her, several figures stand around a large chart or map labeled “AMERICA INDEPENDENCE 1776," with a partially visible kneeling figure pointing to it. To their right, a woman with a star-crowned headdress holds a shield decorated with thirteen stars and strides forward from a cloud, while a small cherub or child stands beneath her. Further to the right, two people stand next to each other, one holding a scroll or banner overhead inscribed with words, while the other holds a staff topped with a cap. Below, centrally located, a man wearing a cocked hat and colonial attire holds the reins of a chariot drawn by two large feline animals. A seated woman rides in the chariot beside him, holding a liberty cap on a staff and a shield, with the chariot labeled “AMERICAN INDEPENDENCE 1776.” In the bottom left, a tree is adorned with a “LIBERTY TREE” ribbon and a liberty cap on a pole, and drums, flags, and weapons are stacked at its base. In the lower right, two figures, one holding a large flag, are near the chariot. Surrounding these central scenes, various plants, hills, and decorative foliage fill the spaces, all drawn in the same reddish-brown hue, creating an intricate and continuous composition.
title: Printed Textile - Historical
